description:
Weak Authentication — SEC0101

Audits mysql.user for accounts using weak or deprecated authentication plugins (mysql_native_password, mysql_old_password). Safe plugins: ed25519, caching_sha2_password, auth_gssapi, unix_socket, parsec.

config_keys.label: Ignored users
config_keys.help: Comma-separated list of user@host pairs or bare usernames to exclude from checks.

config_keys.label: Flag empty-plugin accounts
config_keys.help: When enabled, accounts with empty authentication_string and no explicit plugin are also flagged as weak auth.
